Test Case Name: Verify CGL Portal availability for authorized eligible user
Description: Validate product availability for an authorized user and eligible applicant jurisdiction and transaction type
Action: 1. Authenticate with an authorized user; 2. Start a new transaction; 3. Enter eligible applicant data; 4. Select eligible jurisdiction and transaction type; 5. Open product selection
Expected Result: The CDSPI CGL Portal and applicable CGL product options are displayed and available

Description: Validate that the user can start a new CGL transaction
Action: 1. Open product selection; 2. Select CDSPI Commercial General Liability; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The CGL workflow opens with the correct sections and transaction identifier displayed

Test Case Name: Enter valid applicant and insured information
Description: Validate acceptance of applicant insured contact and mailing information
Action: 1. Open an eligible CGL transaction; 2. Enter valid applicant and insured names; 3. Enter valid contact details and mailing address; 4. Click Continue
Expected Result: All entered applicant and insured values are accepted and saved without validation errors

Description: Validate acceptance of business details required for CGL underwriting
Action: 1. Open the business information section; 2. Enter a valid business name; 3. Enter valid business contact information; 4. Select an eligible business operation; 5. Save
Expected Result: The business information is accepted and displayed in the transaction

Description: Validate acceptance of a valid primary business location
Action: 1. Open the locations section; 2. Enter a valid primary address; 3. Select an eligible jurisdiction; 4. Save
Expected Result: The primary location is saved and displayed with the selected jurisdiction

Description: Validate that an additional eligible CGL location can be added
Action: 1. Complete the primary location; 2. Click Add Location; 3. Enter a second valid address and operation; 4. Save
Expected Result: The additional location is added and included in the transaction exposure details

Description: Validate acceptance of operations and configured CGL classification
Action: 1. Open operations and classification; 2. Select an eligible classification; 3. Enter a valid operation description; 4. Save
Expected Result: The classification and operation description are accepted and retained

Description: Validate acceptance of a valid payroll exposure amount
Action: 1. Select payroll as the exposure basis; 2. Enter a valid positive payroll amount; 3. Leave the field; 4. Save
Expected Result: The payroll exposure is accepted and displayed using the configured format

Description: Validate acceptance of a valid sales exposure amount
Action: 1. Select sales as the exposure basis; 2. Enter a valid positive sales amount; 3. Leave the field; 4. Save
Expected Result: The sales exposure is accepted and displayed using the configured format

Description: Validate the no-subcontractor path
Action: 1. Open subcontractor information; 2. Select No; 3. Continue
Expected Result: No additional subcontractor fields are required and the transaction can proceed

Description: Validate the subcontractor details path
Action: 1. Open subcontractor information; 2. Select Yes; 3. Enter valid subcontractor details; 4. Save
Expected Result: The subcontractor fields are displayed and valid details are saved

Description: Validate the no-claims path
Action: 1. Open claims or incidents history; 2. Select No; 3. Continue
Expected Result: No claims detail section is required and the transaction can proceed

Description: Validate acceptance of claims or incident history details
Action: 1. Open claims or incidents history; 2. Select Yes; 3. Enter valid incident details; 4. Save
Expected Result: The claims details are saved and the configured underwriting status is displayed

Description: Validate selection of an available CGL coverage
Action: 1. Complete valid risk information; 2. Open coverage options; 3. Select a permitted CGL coverage; 4. Save
Expected Result: The selected coverage is displayed in the coverage section

Description: Validate selection of a configured CGL coverage limit
Action: 1. Open coverage limit options; 2. Select an allowed limit; 3. Save
Expected Result: The selected limit is accepted and displayed in the policy summary

Description: Validate selection of a configured deductible
Action: 1. Open deductible options; 2. Select an allowed deductible; 3. Save
Expected Result: The selected deductible is accepted and displayed in the coverage section

Test Case Name: Select permitted extension exclusion and endorsement
Description: Validate configured optional CGL selections
Action: 1. Open extensions exclusions and endorsements; 2. Select one permitted option; 3. Complete any dependent fields; 4. Save
Expected Result: The option is applied and any dependent fields are displayed according to configuration

Description: Validate that a completed partial transaction can be saved as a draft
Action: 1. Enter valid applicant and partial risk information; 2. Click Save Draft; 3. Close the transaction
Expected Result: A draft identifier is displayed and the partial transaction is saved

Description: Validate that saved information is available when the transaction is resumed
Action: 1. Open the saved transaction list; 2. Select the CGL draft; 3. Click Resume
Expected Result: The CGL workflow opens and previously saved values are displayed accurately

Description: Validate premium charges taxes and total calculation for valid inputs
Action: 1. Complete valid applicant risk and coverage data; 2. Click Quote
Expected Result: The system calculates and displays the configured premium applicable charges taxes and total premium

Description: Validate that current transaction data is shown in the policy summary
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Open Policy Summary
Expected Result: The summary displays CGL selections exposures premium transaction status and effective date accurately

Description: Validate document attachment after a successful quote
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Request a quote; 3. Open Documents
Expected Result: The required CDSPI CGL forms endorsements schedules disclosures and supporting documents are attached

Test Case Name: Complete approved bind and issue workflow
Description: Validate policy completion after all validations referrals and approvals pass
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Quote the policy; 3. Complete required approvals; 4. Bind and issue
Expected Result: The policy is bound and issued with the correct status selections rating results and transaction data

Description: Validate audit visibility for transaction changes and generated artifacts
Action: 1. Change a saved CGL value; 2. Save the transaction; 3. Open transaction history
Expected Result: The history displays the relevant change rating inputs approvals referrals and generated document versions

Description: Validate that a user without portal access cannot open the CGL workflow
Action: 1. Authenticate with a user lacking the configured portal role; 2. Attempt to open the CDSPI CGL Portal
Expected Result: The portal denies access or displays the configured access message and no CGL transaction can be started

Description: Validate product eligibility for an ineligible applicant
Action: 1. Start a new transaction; 2. Enter an ineligible applicant or operation; 3. Open product selection
Expected Result: The CGL product is unavailable or the configured eligibility message is displayed

Description: Validate product eligibility for an unsupported jurisdiction
Action: 1. Start a new transaction; 2. Select an unsupported jurisdiction; 3. Open product selection
Expected Result: The CGL product is unavailable or the configured jurisdiction message is displayed

Description: Validate required applicant name behavior
Action: 1. Open an eligible transaction; 2. Leave applicant name empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: A field-level validation message identifies the applicant name and progression is blocked

Description: Validate required business operation behavior
Action: 1. Complete applicant data; 2. Leave business operation empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: A field-level validation message identifies the missing operation and progression is blocked

Description: Validate required primary location behavior
Action: 1. Complete applicant and business data; 2. Do not enter a primary location; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: A location validation message is displayed and progression is blocked

Description: Validate classification validation behavior
Action: 1. Enter an unsupported or invalid classification; 2. Click Continue
Expected Result: The classification is rejected and the configured validation message is displayed

Description: Validate exposure amount format and value behavior
Action: 1. Select an exposure basis; 2. Enter nonnumeric or invalid exposure data; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The exposure field displays a validation message and progression is blocked

Test Case Name: Reject missing subcontractor details when required
Description: Validate conditional subcontractor fields
Action: 1. Select Yes for subcontractors; 2. Leave required subcontractor details empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The required subcontractor fields are identified and progression is blocked

Test Case Name: Reject missing claims details when claims exist
Description: Validate conditional claims fields
Action: 1. Select Yes for claims or incidents; 2. Leave required incident details empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The claims detail fields are identified and progression is blocked

Description: Validate that an unconfigured coverage limit cannot be submitted
Action: 1. Complete valid risk information; 2. Attempt to select or enter an unavailable limit; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The unavailable limit cannot be submitted and the configured message is displayed

Description: Validate configured incompatibility between coverage selections
Action: 1. Select a base coverage; 2. Select an incompatible extension or endorsement; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The incompatible combination is rejected or a referral message is displayed

Test Case Name: Block quote with unresolved validation errors
Description: Validate that quote cannot proceed with blocking errors
Action: 1. Leave one or more required fields invalid; 2. Click Quote
Expected Result: The quote action is blocked and each blocking error is displayed

Test Case Name: Create underwriting referral for configured risk
Description: Validate referral behavior for a risk meeting configured underwriting conditions
Action: 1. Enter risk data that meets a referral condition; 2. Complete other required fields; 3. Click Quote
Expected Result: A referral is created with the configured message and quote or bind completion is blocked

Test Case Name: Prevent bind for configured decline outcome
Description: Validate decline behavior for a risk meeting a configured decline condition
Action: 1. Enter risk data that meets a decline condition; 2. Request a quote or bind
Expected Result: The system displays the decline outcome and prevents policy completion

Description: Validate approval dependency before policy issue
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Quote the policy; 3. Leave required approval incomplete; 4. Click Issue
Expected Result: The issue action is blocked and the outstanding approval is identified

Test Case Name: Prevent document generation for incomplete transaction
Description: Validate document generation dependency on required transaction completion
Action: 1. Open an incomplete transaction; 2. Open Documents or attempt to generate documents
Expected Result: The system prevents final document generation and identifies the incomplete requirements

Description: Validate effective date rules
Action: 1. Enter an invalid or disallowed effective date; 2. Complete other required fields; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The date is rejected and the configured date validation message is displayed

Description: Validate the configured minimum exposure boundary
Action: 1. Select an exposure basis; 2. Enter the configured minimum valid amount; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The minimum valid exposure is accepted and the workflow proceeds

Description: Validate the value immediately below the configured exposure minimum
Action: 1. Select an exposure basis; 2. Enter an amount below the configured minimum; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The exposure is rejected with a boundary validation message

Description: Validate the configured maximum exposure boundary
Action: 1. Select an exposure basis; 2. Enter the configured maximum valid amount; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The maximum valid exposure is accepted and the workflow proceeds

Description: Validate the value immediately above the configured exposure maximum
Action: 1. Select an exposure basis; 2. Enter an amount above the configured maximum; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The exposure is rejected with a boundary validation message

Description: Validate the first option in the configured coverage limit list
Action: 1. Open coverage limits; 2. Select the first permitted option; 3. Save
Expected Result: The first configured limit is accepted and displayed

Description: Validate the last option in the configured coverage limit list
Action: 1. Open coverage limits; 2. Select the last permitted option; 3. Save
Expected Result: The last configured limit is accepted and displayed

Test Case Name: Accept maximum allowed business name length
Description: Validate the configured maximum business name length
Action: 1. Enter a business name at the configured maximum length; 2. Leave the field; 3. Save
Expected Result: The complete business name is accepted without truncation or validation error

Test Case Name: Reject business name over maximum length
Description: Validate business name length enforcement
Action: 1. Enter a business name exceeding the configured maximum length; 2. Leave the field or click Continue
Expected Result: The excess value is rejected or a clear length validation message is displayed

Description: Validate visual indication of mandatory fields
Action: 1. Open each CGL workflow section; 2. Review fields marked as required
Expected Result: All configured mandatory fields have a consistent required indicator

Description: Validate that validation feedback appears beside the affected field
Action: 1. Leave a required field empty; 2. Click Continue; 3. Review the error location
Expected Result: The field-level message appears beside or directly associated with the invalid field

Description: Validate Continue behavior as required fields are completed
Action: 1. Open a workflow section with missing required data; 2. Observe Continue; 3. Enter valid required data; 4. Observe Continue
Expected Result: The button state follows the configured validation behavior and enables progression only when allowed

Description: Validate Quote availability based on transaction completeness
Action: 1. Open an incomplete transaction; 2. Observe Quote; 3. Complete all required data; 4. Observe Quote
Expected Result: Quote is unavailable or blocked while required data is incomplete and available when valid

Description: Validate opening and selecting from the coverage control
Action: 1. Open the coverage dropdown; 2. Review configured options; 3. Select one allowed option
Expected Result: The dropdown opens correctly and the selected coverage is displayed

Description: Validate dynamic visibility based on subcontractor selection
Action: 1. Select No for subcontractors; 2. Observe details section; 3. Select Yes; 4. Observe details section
Expected Result: Subcontractor detail fields are hidden when not applicable and displayed when Yes is selected

Description: Validate dynamic visibility based on claims selection
Action: 1. Select No for claims; 2. Observe claims details; 3. Select Yes; 4. Observe claims details
Expected Result: Claims detail fields are hidden when not applicable and displayed when Yes is selected

Description: Validate visible feedback after saving a draft
Action: 1. Enter valid partial data; 2. Click Save Draft
Expected Result: A save confirmation and draft identifier are displayed

Test Case Name: Verify quote loading and result state
Description: Validate visible state changes during and after quote calculation
Action: 1. Complete valid data; 2. Click Quote; 3. Observe the quote screen
Expected Result: The configured calculation state is shown and the completed premium result is displayed

Description: Validate forward navigation across all required sections
Action: 1. Start a new CGL transaction; 2. Complete each section in order; 3. Click Continue after each section
Expected Result: The user advances through the configured sections in the correct order

Description: Validate backward navigation without losing saved values
Action: 1. Complete and save two sections; 2. Click Back; 3. Review the previous section
Expected Result: The previous section opens and previously saved values remain displayed

Description: Validate navigation from an active transaction to its summary
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Click Policy Summary
Expected Result: The policy summary opens and displays the current transaction values

Description: Validate navigation from summary to generated documents
Action: 1. Complete a quoted transaction; 2. Open Policy Summary; 3. Open Documents
Expected Result: The documents section opens and lists the applicable generated artifacts

Test Case Name: Save draft at each workflow stage
Description: Validate draft persistence at each supported save point
Action: 1. Enter valid data in the applicant section and save; 2. Resume and complete risk data and save; 3. Resume and complete coverage data and save
Expected Result: Each save point retains the entered values and the transaction resumes at the correct state

Description: Validate that an approved referral allows the transaction to proceed
Action: 1. Create a configured underwriting referral; 2. Review the referral; 3. Complete the required resolution; 4. Return to the transaction; 5. Quote or bind
Expected Result: The referral status is updated and the transaction can proceed when all other requirements pass

Test Case Name: Preserve edits after returning from summary
Description: Validate that edits made after summary review are retained
Action: 1. Open a valid policy summary; 2. Return to coverage; 3. Change a permitted deductible; 4. Save; 5. Reopen summary
Expected Result: The changed deductible and any configured premium update are displayed in the summary

Description: Validate conditional field behavior when subcontractors are selected
Action: 1. Select Yes for subcontractors; 2. Review dependent fields; 3. Enter valid values; 4. Save
Expected Result: All configured dependent fields appear and their values are retained

Description: Validate conditional field behavior when claims are selected
Action: 1. Select Yes for claims; 2. Review dependent fields; 3. Enter valid values; 4. Save
Expected Result: All configured claims detail fields appear and their values are retained

Test Case Name: Update rating after exposure basis change
Description: Validate rating behavior when exposure basis changes from payroll to sales
Action: 1. Enter valid payroll exposure; 2. Quote and note premium; 3. Change basis to sales; 4. Enter valid sales exposure; 5. Requote
Expected Result: The rating result updates according to the configured sales-based factors

Description: Validate empty-state behavior when no saved drafts exist
Action: 1. Open saved transactions; 2. Review the list
Expected Result: The portal displays the configured empty-state message and action to start a new transaction

Description: Validate visible referral state after a referral is created
Action: 1. Create a configured referral; 2. Return to the transaction summary
Expected Result: The referral status and required next action are clearly displayed

Description: Validate final policy state after successful issue
Action: 1. Complete all required workflow steps; 2. Bind and issue; 3. Open policy summary
Expected Result: The policy summary displays the configured issued status and final transaction details

Description: Validate that all entered CGL data remains unchanged after save and resume
Action: 1. Enter applicant risk exposure and coverage values; 2. Save; 3. Close and resume; 4. Compare values
Expected Result: All saved values match the values entered before closing

Test Case Name: Verify premium values in policy summary
Description: Validate that rating output is consistent between quote and summary
Action: 1. Complete a valid quote; 2. Record premium charges taxes and total; 3. Open Policy Summary; 4. Compare values
Expected Result: The summary values match the quote values

Description: Validate document version and effective date display
Action: 1. Complete a quoted or issued transaction; 2. Open Documents; 3. Review each required document metadata
Expected Result: Each required document displays the correct configured type version and effective date

Test Case Name: Verify audit record after coverage change
Description: Validate that a coverage change is recorded in history
Action: 1. Save a coverage selection; 2. Change the coverage or deductible; 3. Save; 4. Open audit history
Expected Result: The history shows the changed value and the configured change details
